name: Sian Clifford
bio: Sian Clifford is an English actress. She is best known for playing Claire, the older sister of the titular character in the BBC comedy-drama series Fleabag and also portrayed Martha Crawley in the ITV/Amazon Studios series Vanity Fair. In 2020, she played Diana Ingram in the ITV series Quiz. Wikipedia
